subtitle: English Seminar

keywords: Speaking/ Listening 2.Reading/ Writing 3.PBL 4.Collaboration Competence 5.Cooperating with community
educationalGoal: This course aims to develop the skills to identify and solve problems in the local society. Students will conduct interviews in English, research on the chosen topic/issue and express their ideas through group work and discussions.
advice: The class will be conducted through the following steps: 1. Design Thinking Workshop 2. Ethnographic studies (Interview or photo study) 3. Needs identification 4. Ideation (Generate ideas, develop concept, and select design concept) 5. Prototype construction 6. Proposal of solution and acquisition of user feedback 7. Improvement of prototype based on feedback 8. Presentation of solution Before each class, students must check Moodle and the e-syllabus for any homework or other materials needed for class. Homework includes activities such as interviewing non-Japanese people as well.
requiredKnowledge: Students started English studies at KIT from Topics 5 or passed an intermediate-level course with a grade of A or higher.

activityGoals.body: Be able to conduct interviews (on campus or outside the campus) and collect information in English.
Be able to analyze the data and find problems in English
Be able to find solutions to problems in English.
Be able to understand their role in a group and work collaboratively.
Be able to present their results in English.
